name: myplanner
description: 마이플래너 — 도착 시간에서 거꾸로 계산해 깨워 주는 전 국민 플래너

scripts.cap-sync: npm run build && npx cap sync && node scripts/install-native-alarm.js
scripts.android: npm run cap-sync && npx cap open android
scripts.test: node test/planner.test.js && node test/recur.test.js && node test/live.test.js && node test/parse.test.js && node test/weather.test.js && node test/bus.test.js && node test/nav.test.js && node test/pack.test.js && node test/day.test.js && node test/gohome.test.js && node test/alarmcheck.test.js && node test/edge.test.js && node test/heal.test.js && node test/sync.test.js && node test/clean.test.js && node test/chain.test.js && node test/share.test.js && node --no-warnings test/route-function.test.mjs && node --no-warnings test/ai-function.test.mjs && node --no-warnings test/kakao-login.test.mjs
scripts.test:native: javac -d test/.out native/android/RecheckMath.java native/android/BusMath.java test/java/RecheckMathTest.java test/java/BusMathTest.java && java -Dstdout.encoding=UTF-8 -cp test/.out kr.myplanner.app.RecheckMathTest && java -Dstdout.encoding=UTF-8 -cp test/.out kr.myplanner.app.BusMathTest
scripts.setup:android: npm install && npx cap add android && npm run cap-sync
